summary: Arbitration agreement under MoU limited to appellant and first respondent; third parties (company, bank, non-family shareholders) not bound; Section 8 applications improperly allowed; High Court exceeded jurisdiction under Article 227; impugned order setting aside trial court's dismissal of Section 8 applications set aside; appeals allowed; applications under Section 8 dismissed.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; impugned judgment set aside; Section 8 applications dismissed.
